cards.name: Mayor of Avabruck // Howlpack Alpha
cards.typeLine: Creature — Human Advisor Werewolf // Creature — Werewolf
cards.oracleText:
Other Human creatures you control get +1/+1.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if no spells were cast last turn, transform this creature.
Each other creature you control that's a Werewolf or a Wolf gets +1/+1.
At the beginning of your end step, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform this creature.

cards.name: Ashling's Prerogative
cards.oracleText:
As this enchantment enters, choose odd or even. (Zero is even.)
Each creature with mana value of the chosen quality has haste.
Each creature without mana value of the chosen quality enters tapped.

cards.name: Preferred Selection
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top two cards of your library. You may sacrifice this enchantment and pay {2}{G}{G}. If you do, put one of those cards into your hand. If you don't, put one of those cards on the bottom of your library.
